messages:
mia: 15:12 UTC saw p99 jump to 980ms on hosted API for model-redwood-v2. p95 up to 320ms. Alerts fired.
aj: @mia can you paste shortstack/alerts? any deploys?
mia: deploy-bot shows no deploys at 15:00-15:15. Alert: prod-hosted-p99 > 800ms. Logs show queued_requests spiked.
lee: I see queue_depth on frontends jumped from 5->35, backpressure engaged. Ratecap didn't hit.
nora: attached profiler run (short sample): kernel_selector frequently switching to aux-kernel for shortseqs, cache miss ratio for KV cache up to 28%.
sam: noisy tenant? any correlation with tenant id? metrics -> top tenants show tenant-x spike in QPS, many small requests.
mia: log snippet:
```
[15:12:20] req_id=abc123 tenant=tenant-x seq_len=24 kernel=aux-kernel kv_hit=false queue_pos=23
[15:12:21] req_id=abc124 tenant=tenant-x seq_len=12 kernel=aux-kernel kv_hit=false queue_pos=24
```
aj: that pattern (short seqs routed to aux) causes batching fragmentation. Batching sampler is filling batches with mixed seq lengths -> slower kernels.
lee: I reran a quick flamegraph of batch assembly: coalescer latency ↑ 4-5x when aux is hot; kernel warmup cost per batch + KV miss amplification.
nora: perf profile extract:
- avg batch size dropped 18% during spike
- kernel switch ratio aux/main 72/28
- KV cache miss rate baseline 6% -> spike 28%

sam: sounds like a noisy tenant priming the KV cache and forcing aux-kernel, causing both cache thrash and batching frag. Could also be a tenant with many concurrent short requests.
mia: mitigation idea: temporarily route tenant-x to aux-isolated pool or throttle at edge for short sequences. Also bump prefetch throttle.
aj: agree. Can we flip routing policy to prefer main-kernel for shortseqs until KV cache stabilizes?
lee: main-kernel might degrade quality for certain models? but for short seqs it's fine. I'll open a rollback runbook.
mia: assigned @lee to flip routing and @nora to run cache rewarm script. @sam to monitor. I'll create a rollout with canary of 10% then 100%.
deploy-bot: scheduled routing-change job id=rc-20240315-01 at 15:25 UTC by lee
nora: cache rewarm script started (workers=4) — populating hot prefixes for tenant-x
sam: p95 back down to 150ms at 15:32, p99 at 520ms. still above baseline but improving :thumbsup: 
mia: great. Followups: (1) add kernel-selector hysteresis to avoid flip-flopping under load (2) improve batching sampler to separate aux vs main into different queues (3) detect tenant-induced KV thrash and auto-isolate.
lee: I'll open RFC for sampler change. nora will capture exact profiler traces and ETA for patch.
nora: uploading trace bundle to /tmp/trace-rc-1738204567.tar.gz
sam: closing thread when p99 < 400ms sustained 10m. current last update 15:40 UTC.
